body.objective: Export the action-derived 56-row dynamical apparatus parent as a complete executable unary complex while the independent replacement-112 Phi2 component map is being repaired.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_DYNAMICAL_APPARATUS_PARENT and the executable-unary input-shortfall certificate by exact hash.  Starting from the declared local action, derive and serialize a canonical coefficient domain, 56-row dictionary, degrees/parities, normalized sparse q1 entries, complete odd pairing, real involution, K_Berger action, support-sector and zero-mode matrices, and the detector-smearing chain map.  Recompute nilpotency, cyclicity, pairing rank/nondegeneracy, real/K commutation, support restrictions and detector chain identities directly from entries.  A method-distinct verifier must reconstruct q1 and the pairing from the action's quadratic variation rather than reading the producer matrices.  Match the already certified principal pair and coordinate-level rank-two detector control, but do not infer unexported coefficients from those ranks.  If the action does not determine a row, identify the first missing variational object exactly.
body.current_gate: executable action-derived material-parent-56 unary and pairing export
body.forbid: no isolated 56-row cohomology called the combined physical theory; no ranks or hashes substituted for entries; no apparatus rows identified with replacement rods by name; no q2, q3, Z2, memory, redshift, recoil or quantum promotion; no producer matrices reused by the verifier
activates: one of the two base inputs required to resume the executable 160-row pushout
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER PARALLEL PRODUCER.  Keep this 56-row action-derived export independent of the replacement-112 harmonic-map repair.
notes: Passing this task does not unblock the 160-row consumer until the replacement-112 executable base also passes.
